messages:
elaine_support: Hi — customer reports CSV export from Console > Analytics > Usage yields rows with shifted columns and embedded line breaks. File size ~540KB but most rows appear split across lines when opened in Excel. Pasting a small sample they sent below.

elaine_support: ```
request_id,route,status,user_agent,latency_ms
1,/v1/generate,200,OpenAI-Client/1.2.3,120
2,/v1/embeddings,200,MyAgent
MultiLine/5.0,85
3,/v1/chat,500,RedwoodTestAgent,300
```

luis_support_bot: Thanks! I've created a preliminary ticket and attached the sample. Please include org ID + export filters if available.

maria_analytics: @elaine_support can you confirm the exact export options used (date range, segmentation/group-by, include headers, delimiter)? Also which browser/region the customer used.

elaine_support: Date range: 2026-02-01..2026-02-28, segmentation: route, filters: status=200, region=eu-west-1, UI button: "Download CSV" (default settings). Customer says encoding UTF-8. Browser: Chrome 113 on macOS.

ben_sre: quick glance — looks like the CSV generator didn't quote fields containing newlines (user_agent in line 2). Excel then treats the literal newline as a row break. Suspect missing CSV quoting for multi-line string.

maria_analytics: can you paste the first ~2k bytes of the raw CSV file (not opened in Excel)? we need to confirm if "\n" or "\r\n" is literal in the cell.

elaine_support: here's the raw head: ```
request_id,route,status,user_agent,latency_ms
1,/v1/generate,200,OpenAI-Client/1.2.3,120
2,/v1/embeddings,200,MyAgent
MultiLine/5.0,85
3,/v1/chat,500,RedwoodTestAgent,300
```

ben_sre: yep — field is not wrapped in quotes, newline present inside user_agent. CSV spec requires that fields containing CR/LF be enclosed in quotes and internal quotes escaped. Looks like our analytics export pipeline is skipping the quoting pass when segmentation (route) is enabled and events are flattened.

maria_analytics: creating bug AN-9876: "analytics: CSV export does not escape embedded newlines when segmentation enabled". Repro steps: 1) Console > Analytics > Usage -> set date range, 2) segment by route, 3) apply filter status=200, 4) Download CSV. Observed: fields with embedded newlines are not quoted, causing misaligned rows in Excel. Priority: P2.

deploy-bot: Created issue AN-9876 and opened PR draft (analytics/csv-escape-fix). Canary rollout to staging scheduled in 30m.

maria_analytics: Temporary workarounds: 1) ask customer to import via Excel's "Get Data > From Text/CSV" and set "File Origin: 65001: Unicode (UTF-8)" and enable "Quote character = \"\""; or 2) use the Console's "Export JSON" endpoint (we'll share the raw export URL). We'll notify once patch lands (ETA ~48 hours).

elaine_support: copying customer with suggested workaround. Can we also add a server-side check to force-quote any field containing CR or LF?

maria_analytics: yes that's the planned fix in the PR. I'll update AN-9876 with timeline and a note for support templates.

elaine_support: thanks — will keep customer updated :thumbsup:
